fields.Name: Parameter
fields.Description: Root of the parameter space: trained or hand-authored values a model component consumes.
fields.Story: Parameters carry the knowledge — sometimes learned from data, sometimes written down by someone who already knew.

fields.Name: Hyperparameter Set
fields.Description: Algorithm hyperparameters validated against the leaf SpecSchema.
fields.Story: The knobs that shape how learning happens, not what is learned.

fields.Name: Weight Set
fields.Description: Named weights with per-entry mode (Additive/Multiplier/Gate/Penalty/Bonus), caps/floors — the rubric’s filling. Untrainable and first-class.
fields.Story: Importance made explicit: a human (or a search) saying how much each signal should count, in numbers anyone can audit.

fields.Name: Hand-Authored Matrix
fields.Description: An operator-authored matrix/table consumed as a component (no training).
fields.Story: Institutional knowledge as data: the table someone maintains because they understand the domain better than any fit would.
